senses.gloss: (v. preced.; cmp. יהב to give and to place) to give (not used in perf. tense).
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 19a:11">Sabb. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>במשחא נִיתֵּיב ליה וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>נמשח ונ׳</he>) let him measure when giving (the goods to wash) and when receiving it back.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 78b:11">Kidd. 78ᵇ</cite> <he>אי בעי מִיתְּבָא … לא יהיב ליה</he> (not <he>יהבי</he>) if he desired to give it to him as a donation, could he not do it? <cite ref="Ketubot 106b:14">Keth. 106ᵇ</cite> <he>וליכא למיתבא ליה</he> and he will have nothing to give him.
